observations.name: Jack Daniel’s No.27 Gold Double Barreled
observations.pageText: Winning bid: £60 Jack Daniel’s is a brand of sour mash Tennessee whiskey that is the highest selling American whiskey in the world. It is produced in Lynchburg, Tennessee by the Jack Daniel’s Distillery, which has been owned by the Brown-Forman Corporation since 1956. Despite being the location of a major operational distillery, Jack Daniel’s home county of Moore is a dry county, so the product is not available for consumption at stores or restaurants within the county. Although the product generally meets the regulatory criteria for classification as a straight bourbon, the company disavows this classification and markets it simply as Tennessee whiskey rather than as Tennessee bourbon. One of the whiskey giants limited edition bottlings, which is twice charcoal mellowed in golden-hued maple barrels. 40% ABV / 70cl Please note minor wear to box Please examine all images of the lot, any packaging and labels carefully and satisfy yourself as to their condition before making a bid.

Despite being the location of a major operational distillery, Jack Daniel’s home county of Moore is a dry county, so the product is not available for consumption at stores or restaurants within the county. Jack Daniel’s Master Distiller N°6 is the sixth edition of a limited series on the Master Distillers of Jack Daniel’s Tennessee Whiskey. Only seven men (as of 2017) have overseen the production of this legendary Tennessee whiskey. This line goes right back to Mr Jack himself. This edition celebrates Jimmy Bedford who was Master Distiller from 1988 until 2008. 43% ABV / 70cl Bottle Number: 7624 Please note minor scuffing and tear on carton. Please examine all images of the lot, any packaging and labels carefully and satisfy yourself as to their condition before making a bid.
